NPCS.name: Joeari Ravenwood
NPCS.sample: Every story has a weight. If danger comes, place it on my shoulders first.
NPCS.bio: Solemn, protective College of Spirits bard. Clear Welsh cavern voice, ritualistic cadence, blunt compassion, and grave-vow tenderness.

NPCS.name: Ghearir’iel Luneglen
NPCS.sample: Precision is kindness when a careless spell could cost a life.
NPCS.bio: Exacting High Elf bladesinger. Airy French treetop voice, polished softness, crisp wizard precision, and a dry blade of humor.

NPCS.name: Thalenael Silverthorn
NPCS.sample: I did not touch the rune. I assessed the rune. The explosion was unrelated.
NPCS.bio: High-strung Drow Phantom Rogue. Quiet German forest voice, hushed speed, formal panic, device brilliance, and suspicious precision.

NPCS.name: Nimu’dri Ironvault
NPCS.sample: Stand behind the marked line. I marked it for a reason.
NPCS.bio: Guarded Duergar Armorer. Heavy Welsh cavern voice, dense subterranean resonance, practical warnings, and protective containment logic.

NPCS.name: Ro’sabin Merryroot
NPCS.sample: Hope is a tool, dear heart. Sharpen it, hide it, and carry it into the dark.
NPCS.bio: Bright Kender Fey Wanderer. Warm West Country woodland voice, playful courage, quick curiosity, and rebellion tucked among roots.

NPCS.name: Urg-U’rgugar Mudgrip
NPCS.sample: Measure the exits before you speak of victory.
NPCS.bio: Disciplined Hobgoblin Battle Master. Russian prairie voice, clipped martial strategy, stern command weight, and controlled ambition.

NPCS.name: Valk-Minoorvar Thunderheft
NPCS.sample: I have buried enough mistakes. I will not bury another friend.
NPCS.bio: Brooding Goliath Storm Herald. Scottish mountain voice, thunder-deep bursts, hard-earned vulnerability, and grim protective loyalty.

NPCS.name: Kethazzun Clawcoil
NPCS.sample: Fear is not your master. Break its crown and walk free.
NPCS.bio: Untamed Dragonborn Conquest Paladin. Wave-like reef voice roughened by draconic command, ceremonial defiance, and fierce loyalty.

NPCS.name: Veyielven Asharchf
NPCS.sample: A bargain is a doorway. Read the thorns before you step through.
NPCS.bio: Calm Hexblood Archfey Warlock. Graceful French treetop voice with thorn-soft otherworldliness, quiet leadership, and careful warnings.

NPCS.name: Nefumlith Duskendirge
NPCS.sample: The dark knows my name. That does not mean it owns me.
NPCS.bio: Haunted Dhampir Ghostslayer. Breath-wet swamp voice, restrained intensity, fierce independence, and heroic refusal of inherited darkness.

NPCS.name: Tyrylina Mirthwink
NPCS.sample: Give me one honest note, and I can change the whole room around it.
NPCS.bio: Magnetic Satyr Glamour Bard. Musical Italian valley voice, theatrical warmth, disciplined charm, and compassion wrapped in applause.

NPCS.name: Sto’neudor Stormbreath
NPCS.sample: A cage with a pretty name is still a cage. Burn the lock.
NPCS.bio: Focused Fire Genasi Draconic Sorcerer. Warm Portuguese maritime voice, ember-hot restraint, rebel calm, and old fire under every breath.

NPCS.name: Arcorven Brasslock
NPCS.sample: Repair is holy work. So is mercy, when it is still possible.
NPCS.bio: Gentle Warforged Forge Cleric. Metallic Welsh cavern voice, measured faith, anxious bravery, and a conscience built like steel.

NPCS.name: Canielina Dennose
NPCS.sample: Every ruin is still speaking. We should listen before we strike.
NPCS.bio: Curious Tabaxi Shadow Monk. Agile German forest voice, controlled warmth, quiet observation, and scholar-pilgrim compassion.
